caption: The video captures a high-speed view of white button mushrooms interacting with a water surface against a pure black background. A horizontal water line sits near the middle, with a loose cluster of submerged mushrooms held nearly motionless beneath it, showing only slow rotations of individual caps. At the surface a turbulent foamy splash crown churns continuously, its broad lateral arms reshaping while the central bubble column shifts toward a more upright shape. Scattered droplets and bubbles hang above and below the line, and airborne spray remains dispersed through the segment. A mushroom above the splash sinks and becomes partly engulfed by the white turbulence, while additional caps enter from the upper edge and fall toward the impact zone. The water line and black background remain fixed throughout.
